title: Staged ES/FR overlay bundle for the Nubia NX809J

divergences: no APK is staged: the runner already exists as two installed packages, and the scripts refuse to run unless both are present
no QAIRT pin machinery: the route is CPU-only, so there is no context/runtime pair to match

safety.shellcheck: clean with -x over all seven shell files
enforced: exactly one authorized NX809J/SM8850 arm64 target
zero adb forwards before and after every script
both packages already installed, single unsplit APK each
run-as resolves to the companion UID and is neither root nor shell
byte size and SHA-256 verified on host and again after import
atomic placement via a .incoming temporary and mv
refusal of any payload row that looks like a QNN context or a Qualcomm runtime object (exit 24)
rollback asserts the accepted EN/ZH/JA/KO/RU assets survive
